key_insight: The LLM adapts neural operator fine-tuning by combining a task-dependent prior from the PDE description with sensitivity to validation feedback.
engineering_relevance: This suggests LLM-based hyperparameter controllers can outperform random search and Bayesian optimization for PDE model transfer under tight trial budgets.
method: Compared LLM-selected fine-tuning configurations against random search and Bayesian optimization across PDE transfer settings.
Used controlled interventions to separate initial task bias from feedback-driven adaptation.
Tested whether changing or permuting validation scores alters the next configuration proposal.
evidence_signal: Across matched comparisons, the LLM achieved lower held-out test nRMSE in nearly every case, and interventions showed the first proposal was task-informed while later proposals changed with feedback.
watch_item: Results depend on a limited trial budget and controlled test setups, so broader robustness across more PDEs and training regimes still needs verification.
paper_title: Prior or Feedback? What an LLM Uses When Adapting Neural Operators
